steps.what: Open the stored list of titles for the display
Assist in the preparation of book displays

tasks.design: The assistant assists in preparing book displays. {DOCS} opens the title list when the display identifier is stored. A missing list stays blank, and the assistant still builds the display with the librarian.
tasks.previous_blocker: The title list was a scrap of paper, and the display was built from it.
tasks.enabler_now: A known display name can open the list.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the table, standing the books, and judging the look stay physical.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant will not put out a book the list names if the copy in hand is the wrong one.
tasks.altitude: The display is still built by hand. The list is only easier to find.

reach.task: Choose the titles and the audience for the display
reach.learn: Which titles the librarian has dropped since the list was stored.

evidence.claim: A stored display identifier can open a title list. Building the display stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a display to prepare and ends when the books are out or the assistant stops.
A display row has display identifier and title identifiers, entered by a librarian. A missing list is left blank.
The list is read, not published, in this task.
unknowns: Who signs off the display before it is opened to patrons.
research_questions: How often was the stored list already out of date?

already_counted.description: Preparing the book display is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Correct a title on the list after the librarian drops it.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: lists are often missing, so the display is built as today. High: the list opens, and standing the books remains. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Classify items according to content and purpose
Review the catalog class before it is filed

tasks.design: The assistant classifies the item according to its content and purpose, then reviews that class. {DOCS} files the catalog entry only for the accepted class. The subject is not chosen by a model. A blank class is not filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The assistant chose the class and then retyped the heading into the catalog.
tasks.enabler_now: Once the class is chosen, filing that heading is a write of a known value.
tasks.still_hard: Reading the item and choosing the class stay with the assistant.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant changes the class when the content does not match the first heading.
tasks.altitude: Classification stays a judgement. Filing happens only for the class the assistant accepted.

reach.task: Settle a class the assistant will not choose alone
reach.learn: Which subjects are referred before filing.

evidence.claim: A class the assistant has already chosen can be filed as a catalog entry. Choosing the class stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with an item to classify and ends when the accepted class is filed or the assistant stops.
The assistant records item identifier and class heading. A blank heading is not invented and is not filed.
The file uses the class accepted in the review. A later change of class voids that acceptance.
unknowns: Which classification scheme the library uses.
research_questions: How often did the review change the class before filing?

already_counted.description: Classifying items by content and purpose is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Correct a heading the assistant has not yet accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: most items need a slow reading, so filing is a small part. High: the class is chosen and reviewed, and only that heading is filed. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Operate a small branch under supervisors

steps.what: Open the branch day list the supervisor stored
Operate small branch libraries under librarian supervisors
Follow the direction of the off-site supervisors

tasks.design: The assistant operates a small branch under the direction of off-site librarian supervisors. {DOCS} opens the day list the supervisor stored. A missing list stays blank. Running the branch and following direction stay with the assistant.
tasks.previous_blocker: The day's jobs were a phone call the assistant had to remember.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored day list can be opened at the branch.
tasks.still_hard: Opening the branch, serving it, and taking direction stay in person.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant calls the supervisor when the day list does not cover the situation in the branch.
tasks.altitude: Operating the branch stays the week. The day list is visible without waiting for the call.

reach.task: Direct the branch for the day

evidence.claim: A stored branch identifier can open a day list. Operating the branch stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts at the branch open and ends at close, including the supervisor's direction.
A day-list row has branch identifier and tasks, entered by the supervisor. A missing list is left blank.
The list does not run the branch. Upkeep is telling the supervisor when a line is wrong.
unknowns: Which decisions the off-site supervisor keeps.
research_questions: How often did the assistant set aside the day list?

already_counted.description: Operating the small branch library is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Tell the supervisor when a day-list line does not match the branch.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the day list is often empty, so the branch runs as today. High: the list opens, and operating the branch plus taking direction remain. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and join library programs such as story time

steps.what: Plan library events and programs, including story time
Participate in story time with children

tasks.design: The assistant plans library events and programs, including story time, and participates in the session. {DOCS} opens the outline when the program identifier is stored. A missing outline stays blank. Being in the room stays with the assistant.
tasks.previous_blocker: The outline was rewritten for each session, and the session itself was always in the room.
tasks.enabler_now: A known program can open the last outline.
tasks.still_hard: Planning the room, and taking part in story time, stay in person.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant changes the plan when the group in the room is not the group on the outline.
tasks.altitude: Story time stays in the room. The outline is only a starting page.

reach.task: Choose the program and the age it is for
reach.learn: Which programs the librarian wants the assistant to lead.

evidence.claim: A stored program identifier can open an outline. Planning and taking part in the session stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a program to plan and ends when the session is over or the plan is left with the librarian.
An outline row has program identifier and notes, entered by the librarian or the assistant after the last session. A missing outline is left blank.
Taking part in the session is not shortened. No one is scored.
unknowns: Which programs the assistant leads and which a librarian leads.
research_questions: How often was the stored outline set aside once the group arrived?

already_counted.description: Participating in story time is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Correct the outline after the session so the next plan starts from what happened.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the session is the work, and the outline is rarely reused. High: the outline opens, and planning plus being in the room remain. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The assistant still meets patrons, shelves items, and handles cash. A record, notice, invoice, or order is written or sent only after the assistant accepts that version.
reach: A librarian receives the question the assistant could not answer from the desk.
A finance colleague receives only an invoice the assistant has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required field is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a send or a write.
Keep shelving, cash, and patron conversations in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every item on loan has a location and a due date the desk can trust, and the assistant still decides the exception.
